title: OpenPlanning Staff Report Schema v1
description: Defines staff reports authored by planning staff for a deciding body. A staff report is the structured analysis presented at a hearing: title, summary, background, analysis, action requested, recommendation, suggested motion. May be linked to an agenda item (one-to-one) and/or an application, and may reference a source PDF document.

municipality.description: Municipality these staff reports belong to.

agenda_item_ref.description: Natural key for an AgendaItem: jurisdiction + meeting date + order (or item title as fallback). The pair (jurisdiction, meeting_date) resolves a Meeting; (meeting, order) resolves an AgendaItem.

title.description: Agenda item title. Used to resolve when order is not provided or ambiguous.

application_ref.description: Natural key for an Application. Tries application_number, file_number, then title within the jurisdiction.

document_ref.description: Natural key for a documents.Document within the municipality. Resolved by source_url first, then by name.

citation.description: An embedded citation linking the host staff report to a legal.Block. The host's jurisdiction (via staff_report.application.jurisdiction or municipality jurisdiction) is inherited; the spec only carries section_number for block resolution. Re-loading the same fixture is idempotent (keyed on (jurisdiction, block, staff_report)).

section_number.description: Block.section_number (e.g. '180-137'). Resolved within the host staff report's jurisdiction. If multiple versions exist, the current version (is_current=True) is preferred.

excerpt.description: Verbatim quote from the host document supporting the citation.

note.description: Editor's note explaining the citation's relevance.

created_by.description: Origin tag, e.g. 'openplanning' or 'seed'. Defaults to 'openplanning' when omitted.

staff_report.description: A single staff report. Identity: if `id` is set, it is the canonical primary key (UUID). Otherwise the loader falls back to natural keys: agenda_item OneToOne if present, else (municipality, application, title). At least one of agenda_item, application, or title must be set.

id.description: Stable UUID primary key. When set, this is the canonical identifier across environments. Generated by the source system on first publish.

title.description: Human-readable report title. Required when no agenda_item is provided.

agenda_item.description: Agenda item where this report is presented. OneToOne ,  only one staff report per agenda item.

summary.description: Brief summary read at the top of the hearing. Plain text or markdown.

background.description: History and context. Plain text or markdown.

analysis.description: Staff's substantive analysis and findings. Plain text or markdown.

action_requested.description: What staff is asking the deciding body to do.

recommendation.description: Staff's formal recommendation. Empty string is allowed for drafts.

suggested_motion.description: Pre-drafted motion language for the chair to read.

prepared_date.description: Date staff finished preparing the report.

prepared_by_email.description: Email of the user who prepared the report. Resolved against users.User; null if no match.

source_document.description: The PDF this report was extracted from, when applicable.

citations.description: Code citations attached to this staff report. Each entry creates or updates a Citation row keyed by (jurisdiction, block, staff_report). Edges are additive across loads.
